as_told.title: Tim Taylor gives Diana Pasulka a hierarchy of being

plain: This story is about Timothy Taylor, described as a NASA programme manager long involved in strange and secretive subjects, who was once anonymous and is now fairly well known. According to a guest named Matthew Pines, a religion scholar named Diana Pasulka asked Taylor what the hierarchy is, meaning the ranking of beings, human and non-human. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, repeats it, saying Taylor laid out for Pasulka a hierarchy of beings. Neither gives the full answer here. If true, it would mean someone inside the space agency claims to know an order of intelligent beings above us.
